description: Get time-in-status data for multiple tasks in one call. Returns per-task status durations. Use to compare cycle time across a set of tasks.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true when task_ids are custom task IDs instead of native ClickUp IDs. Requires team_id.

task_ids.description: IDs of the tasks to analyze.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: get_bulk_tasks_time_in_status
